prompts.hero: Create a single high-fidelity desktop website section design reference for the REAL personal portfolio of Rikelme Batista, software developer and founder/owner of A-NFC. New direction: pure black #000000 everywhere on page backgrounds, electric royal blue secondary #2563eb and readable lighter blue #6291ff for text, pure white #ffffff tertiary for content, muted cool gray #a5adbd. Crisp Archivo/Geist sans serif only, no serif, no amber or bronze, no warm colors. Premium precise technology founder identity, asymmetry, substantial whitespace, thin restrained blue-gray dividers, not a generic SaaS template, no fake stats, no excessive pills or nested boxes. Landscape straight-on responsive website comp, one section only, all Portuguese text readable, flat real UI screenshot. Design the opening viewport with navigation at top: 'Rikelme Batista.' on left and 'Projetos', 'Sistemas', 'Sobre', 'Contato' on right. Large left aligned headline EXACT 'Código. Produto.' then blue 'Negócio.' on two lines. Above it small but readable personal role 'Desenvolvedor & fundador da A-NFC'. Below headline: 'Sou desenvolvedor de software e fundador da A-NFC. Construo sites, sistemas e automações que conectam tecnologia ao negócio.' Primary royal-blue filled button with white text 'Explore os projetos', secondary text link 'Conheça a A-NFC'. Right side is an elegant animated-wave impression of thin blue parallel threads inspired by React Bits Threads; no neon glow, no cubes, no fake dashboard. Lower left a real company identity lockup: a small white rectangular plate containing the supplied A-NFC original logo, next to white text 'A-NFC' and gray 'Tecnologia que aproxima físico e digital'. Footer thin rule with 'Feira de Santana, Brasil'. Owner identity is prominent but personal name remains. Fit the first viewport at 1366x768 without clutter or CTA clipping. Supplied image is official logo reference; preserve its shape and original blue/black and place on small white plate to preserve legibility on black.
